Interface CustomContainerScreen.ScreenEventListener

Enclosing class:
CustomContainerScreen
public static interface CustomContainerScreen.ScreenEventListener
Listener for events inside this screen. Every method does nothing by default, so override only what you need.

The callbacks pass a CreatedSlot, the library's handle for a created slot, rather than a raw vanilla Slot. It carries CreatedSlot.address() (the slot's Address) plus groupId() and getLocalIndex() for display.

    • onQuickMove

      default void onQuickMove(CreatedSlot sourceSlot, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack movedStack)
      A shift-click (quick move) is about to happen on a CreatedSlot. Fires before vanilla routes the items, so the destination isn't known yet. movedStack is a copy of what is in the source.

      Shift-click only. Other ways items move (drag-collect, double-click collect, hopper insertion, cursor placement, creative middle-click) do not fire it; the name matches vanilla's quickMoveStack on purpose. For those, use the relevant hooks directly.

      For logging, analytics or checks before the transfer. Seeing where the items ended up would need a later onAfterQuickMove event fired from quickMoveStack.
